objective: Dispatch one bounded deterministic task to exactly two isolated fixture attempts and preserve independent verifier outcomes without automatic integration.

context.summary: Phase A0 fixture for issue #4. It proves orchestration, failure isolation, canonical ResultManifest generation, independent verification, and replay before the real local-node adapter is accepted.

outputs.description: An isolated JSON candidate independently evaluated by the canonical local verifier.

policies: Each attempt receives an isolated candidate root
Candidate workers cannot modify verifier code or verifier-owned policy
Worker success is never final acceptance
No majority vote converts worker claims into truth
No automatic integration or merge authority

uncertainty.statement: Fixture workers exercise the orchestration boundary but are not evidence that the real local-node worker is safe or accepted.
uncertainty.resolution_strategy: Introduce the canonical local-node adapter only after PR #34 is synchronized and controlled-Docker acceptance #37 is satisfied.

security.notes: Phase A0 writes only deterministic JSON fixtures inside bounded run workspaces and never executes candidate-supplied code.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Each successful worker candidate must independently pass artifact digest, candidate scope, and verifier-owned acceptance checks.

validators.description: Observed candidate bytes must match the worker ResultManifest artifact digest.
The isolated candidate directory may contain only verifier-policy-approved files.
Verifier-owned deterministic expectations must pass independently of worker self-report.

evidence_requirements.description: Record the observed SHA-256 of each successful candidate artifact.
Retain independent acceptance evidence and diagnostics per successful attempt.
